features: Volt Studio slots: overflow-fit control (clip/ellipsis/shrink), on-canvas binding indicator (shows the bound product field), body/paragraph text slot option, and lighter less-obstructive slot affordance
Flexible Designer: per-element toggle to render an element in front of the section Lower Third (opt-in, default off)
Volt Studio: bind a slot to a product field (Name/Speed/Price/Options/Period) so linked product cards auto-populate the slot end-to-end
Volt Studio: editable vector/polygon points — add anchor points anywhere, corner/smooth node toggle, 45° straight-side snap
Volt Studio: per-state on-canvas editing — drag/resize/rotate shapes independently per hover state
Volt Studio: per-state shape outline morph on hover (instant swap)
Volt Studio: vector point-edit constraints — Shift axis-lock, Ctrl inline anchor sliding, select + Delete to remove a single point
Volt Studio: always-visible context hint bar for vertex/polygon/pen tools
Data-bound product cards — link Volt cards to coverage packages; auto-populate name, speed, price and options from live product data
bugfixes: Volt Studio: canvas size presets/custom now apply, persist, render saved size; selection outline tracks rotated & duplicated shapes; arrow-key nudging selected layers
Hero carousel: tall slide content on mobile now scrolls within the slide instead of clipping
Hero carousel: slide text isolated per slide (no outlined-word bleed during transitions)
Hero carousel: mobile slide sizing — slide 1 no longer oversized on phones
Flexible Designer: stable marquee drag-select (no full-page text highlight or selection flicker)
Flexible Designer: tablet preview vertical spacing matches design ratio
Volt: polygon/pen no longer curves a straight-clicked side
Volt Studio: image, slot and 3D-object layers can now be rotated (rotation applied on canvas + live render)
Flexible Designer: tablet/live 768px boundary reconciled (iPad-portrait renders as tablet, not mobile); hardened autoScalePos vertical scaling
